structure: CSharp InferFlowExpressionCore carries currentType through the selected value-flow targets and returns the terminal FlowResult.Type. Its structured if/when inference consumes branch results. SLG sourceExpressionValueIndex maps the complete original source expression to that terminal control/value IR, consumed by interpolation_inference expressionTypeId.
branches: Ordinary source values; terminal if(kind18), loop(kind20), enum/subject when(kind27/33/34),fold(kind32); same source module and root ancestry only; exclude function/result/declaration IR0/1/11; choose closest source root and require the actual control root for control targets. Invalid ranges or absent matches return no value rather than using the flow source as its result.
logic: Source ownership stays attached to the complete expression, while materialized result/type comes from the terminal target. This preserves CSharp final expression type authority without choosing a shallower operand as an alternative result. Read all source_values.slg branches and its interpolation consumer; no compiler edits.
diagnostics: No new user diagnostic or relaxed condition. A missing/invalid IR value remains unresolved(-1), consumed by existing checked typing rather than an invented default.
